verses.arabicText: حمٓ
verses.englishText: Ḥā, Meem.[1458]

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.englishText: By the clear Book,

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.[1459] Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
verses.footnotes: [1459] The Night of Decree (Qadr). See Sūrah al-Qadr.

verses.arabicText: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.englishText: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct[1460] every precise matter -
verses.footnotes: [1460] Or "is separated" or "apportioned," from what is inscribed in the Preserved Slate. The angels record and descend with whatever Allāh has decreed for the coming year.

verses.arabicText: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.englishText: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

verses.arabicText: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.englishText: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

verses.arabicText: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.englishText: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

verses.arabicText: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.englishText: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

verses.arabicText: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.englishText: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

verses.arabicText: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.englishText: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

verses.arabicText: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.englishText: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

verses.arabicText: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.englishText: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

verses.arabicText: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.englishText: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.englishText: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.englishText: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.englishText: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

verses.arabicText: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.englishText: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.[1461] Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

verses.arabicText: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.englishText: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.englishText: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.[1462]
verses.footnotes: [1462] To death. Or "lest you assault me [with your tongues or harm me otherwise]."

verses.arabicText: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.englishText: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

verses.arabicText: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.englishText: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

verses.arabicText: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.englishText: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

verses.arabicText: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.englishText: And leave the sea in stillness.[1463] Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
verses.footnotes: [1463] After it has parted, in order that the soldiers of Pharaoh would follow the Children of Israel and be drowned.

verses.arabicText: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.englishText: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

verses.arabicText: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.englishText: And crops and noble sites

verses.arabicText: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.englishText: And comfort wherein they were amused.

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.englishText: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

verses.arabicText: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.englishText: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.englishText: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

verses.arabicText: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.englishText: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.englishText: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

verses.arabicText: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.englishText: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.englishText: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

verses.arabicText: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.englishText: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

verses.arabicText: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.englishText: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ[1464] and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.englishText: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

verses.arabicText: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.englishText: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.englishText: The Day when no relation[1465] will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
verses.footnotes: [1465] i.e., patron, protector or close associate.

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.englishText: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

verses.arabicText: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.englishText: Is food for the sinful.

verses.arabicText: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.englishText: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

verses.arabicText: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.englishText: Like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.arabicText: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.englishText: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.englishText: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

verses.arabicText: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.englishText: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble![1466]
verses.footnotes: [1466] As he had claimed upon the earth. He is taunted with these words in Hell as a reminder and additional torment.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.englishText: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
verses.englishText: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

verses.arabicText: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.englishText: Within gardens and springs,

verses.arabicText: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.englishText: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.englishText: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.arabicText: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.englishText: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

verses.arabicText: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.englishText: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

verses.arabicText: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.englishText: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

verses.arabicText: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.englishText: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

verses.arabicText: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.englishText: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
